{{Top|leg}}
'''Black Queen''' was a title that was taken by the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zelice Sturm]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], after she abandoned the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and became the leader of a [[Genarius]]-based [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] gang. However, she was later redeemed by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], and she forsook the title.
